 By Sam Sachs, WSBTV.com November 17, 2026 at 12:31 pm EST Enter Fullscreen Expand Two types of pasta sold by ALDI were recalled in Georgia and three other states due to a reported botulism risk. By Sam Sachs, WSBTV.com November 17, 2026 at 12:31 pm EST GEORGIA — German supermarket company ALDI recalled a series of pasta products sold in Georgia and three other states due to a possible health risk.
 According to the recall announcement provided by the company, ALDI is recalling its Priano Protein Carbonarra Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni because of a possible risk of Clostridium botulinum being present in the food items.
 The pasta products in question were sold in Alabama, Georgia, North Carolina and South Carolina, according to the recall.
 [DOWNLOAD: Free WSB-TV News app for alerts as news breaks ] 
 C. botulinum is a bacterium that can cause life-threatening illness or death if consumed. While not a guarantee, the botulinum bactera does release a toxin that can be fatal.
 The C. botulinum bacteria is known for its ability to call a food poisoning that can cause general weakness, dizziness, double vision and trouble speaking or swallowing.
 TRENDING STORIES:

 3-year-old dies, police charge 20-year-old with child cruelty, aggravated battery 
 STORY 3 
 Consumers who have had the pasta in question recently may experience abdominal distension, muscle weakness, difficulty breathing, dizziness, general weakness, double vision and trouble speaking or swallowing.
 Anyone who has these symptoms is encouraged to seek medical attention immediately.
 The recall warning said the products were sold both in stores and online from stores in all four states.
 So far, ALDI says no illnesses have been reported in relation to the recall.
 The following items are included in the recall:
 Product   Lot Number   Best if Used By   Packaging   
 Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni  T9101926  12/18/2026  9 oz. plastic unit  
 Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni  T9101926  12/18/2026  9 oz. plastic unit  
 Anyone with questions can call ALDI at 844-484-0332, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
